response.answer: A 3-year retrospective study in a Thai Red Cross Society hospital lab identified pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical errors using descriptive stats and six sigma metrics to enhance quality and reduce preventable test errors. The study aimed to pinpoint error patterns for quality improvement.
